description: Synthetic fixed observations for search-rank.jpp (construction check only; not model evaluation). Feasibility is a yes/no question; memorability is a scored question used only for ranking by expected level. Round 0: two fitting names (expected levels 1.0 and 0.4) and one rejected; round 1: a better name (1.8), a re-proposed name and another fitting one (0.5); round 2: a new name tying the second-best (1.0), a re-proposed name and a rejected one, so the top two do not change and the search ends at noshrink. The calibration record is hand-written to exercise routing.
